# DDInter 2.0 source files

The eight ATC-grouped interaction files (A, B, D, H, L, P, R, V) from
<https://ddinter2.scbdd.com/download/>, unmodified. `data_pipeline.refresh_db`
reads them to attach expert severity grades to the DrugBank interaction pairs.
